# SMS reminder provider: Sinch

Decided on 2026-10-13 by Maya Okafor, Tom Lindqvist, Priya Raman, Daniel Reyes, Sofia Marchetti and Kenji Watanabe.

## Decision
SMS reminder provider is **Sinch**. Go-live planned from 2026-11-01.

This replaces Decision - SMS reminder provider is Vonage (28e1671), which is no longer current.

payload.name: Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog Cloud (EU region)
payload.body:
# Product analytics vendor: PostHog Cloud (EU region)

Decided on 2026-10-14 by Maya Okafor and Tom Lindqvist.

## Decision
Product analytics vendor is **PostHog Cloud (EU region)** rather than self-hosted.

## Why
Self-hosting PostHog is consuming too much ops time; choosing Cloud in the EU keeps clinic data in-region while reducing operational load.

This replaces Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog self-hosted (f004a28), which is no longer current.

payload.value: Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog Cloud (EU region)

payload.reason: Daniel and Tom agreed to change release cadence to reduce mid-day surprises for pilot clinics.
payload.name: Decision - Release cadence is twice-weekly (Tuesdays and Thursdays) behind feature flags
payload.body:
# Release cadence: twice-weekly (Tuesdays and Thursdays) behind feature flags

Decided on 2026-10-15 by Daniel Reyes and Tom Lindqvist.

## Decision
Release cadence is **twice-weekly releases on Tuesdays and Thursdays**, still deployed behind feature flags.

## Why
Continuous deploys were surprising pilot clinics during the day; a twice-weekly schedule reduces unexpected changes while keeping feature flags for control.

This replaces Decision - Release cadence is continuous deploys behind feature flags (316a7a9), which is no longer current.

payload.value: Decision - Release cadence is twice-weekly (Tuesdays and Thursdays) behind feature flags

payload.reason: Maya reported Brightpath requested slowing investor updates; team agreed to revert to monthly cadence while keeping the metrics dashboard link.
payload.name: Decision - Investor update cadence is monthly update with a metrics dashboard link
payload.body:
# Investor update cadence: monthly update with a metrics dashboard link

Decided on 2026-10-16 by Maya Okafor.

## Decision
Investor update cadence is **monthly**, and we keep the metrics dashboard link in updates.

## Why
Brightpath requested slower updates; reverting to monthly balances investor communication load while keeping transparency via the dashboard.

This replaces Decision - Investor update cadence is fortnightly update with a metrics dashboard link (4c97825), which is no longer current.

payload.value: Decision - Investor update cadence is monthly update with a metrics dashboard link
